name: sentinel6
description: Local security scanners with explicit coverage reporting

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/core.js && node --check src/parsers.js && node --check src/process.js

sentinel6.executables.description: Trusted absolute executable paths keyed by semgrep, osv, gitleaks, trivy. No shell commands.

sentinel6.caches.description: User-level absolute offline cache paths keyed by osv and trivy. No automatic downloads.
